definitions.cache_hit_tokens_engine_reported: LEVEL=ENGINE_RUNTIME; SOURCE=info.cachedPromptTokenCount/reportedCacheHit; tokens reused from KV, engine measured.
definitions.cache_reuse_mode_engine_reported: LEVEL=ENGINE_RUNTIME; SOURCE=info.cacheReuseMode; cold => prior compute re-prefilled.
definitions.forward_calls: NOT_INSTRUMENTED (no per-forward hook in this layer; use generation_tokens as an ENGINE_RUNTIME token-granularity proxy, explicitly labelled).
definitions.generation_tokens_engine_reported: LEVEL=ENGINE_RUNTIME; SOURCE=info.generationTokenCount; decode tokens ≈ forward passes at token granularity (approximate; per-layer forward NOT_INSTRUMENTED).
definitions.physical_page_return: NOT_INSTRUMENTED/BLOCKED — malloc_zone_pressure_relief is only an allocator HINT; no independent evidence the OS reclaimed physical pages (footprint/RSS diffs are explicitly excluded by the gate definition).
definitions.prefill_tokens_observed: LEVEL=ENGINE_RUNTIME; SOURCE=NativeMLX prefill.progress(total); actual tokens the engine prefilled for the executed request (not requested tokens).
definitions.reference_release: LEVEL=LIFECYCLE_EVENT; SOURCE=suspend path state mutation; sessions_before/after and container_present_before/absent_after are READ FROM RUNTIME STATE by the caller (not asserted by the recorder). model_container_ref_dropped is derived as present_before && absent_after. Proves in-process logical REFERENCE release only — NOT that ARC/MLX freed memory back to the OS.
definitions.resource_reclaim: LEVEL=LIFECYCLE_EVENT; SOURCE=Memory.clearCache() returned; count of explicit MLX cache-reclaim OPERATIONS INVOKED on the production suspend path. Records invocation only — reclaimed bytes are not observable here, and this is NOT physical page return.

produce_prompt_text: Output exactly one line and nothing else: RESULT=hello
